item.title: the case for testing
item.author: Brenner Cruvinel
item.description:
Short post: testing is one of those things that looks simple until it isn’t.

why it matters

Testing shows up across programming work more often than it deserves credit for. The details are small, but they compound.

what works for me

  • The fix that survives is the one the next person can understand.
  • Name it after what it does, not after how it does it.
  • Most of the value is in deleting, not adding.

None of this is a law. It is just the shape that kept working after enough mistakes.

item.title: testing, revisited
item.author: Brenner Cruvinel
item.description:
I keep coming back to testing, so here are the notes I wish I had earlier.

why it matters

Testing shows up across programming work more often than it deserves credit for. The details are small, but they compound.

what works for me

  • Make the default path the correct path so nobody has to remember the rule.
  • Prefer the obvious solution; clever costs interest forever.
  • Most of the value is in deleting, not adding.

None of this is a law. It is just the shape that kept working after enough mistakes.
